ResourceScope: Parent plus registered OCR child processes; working sets and threads sampled together every100ms; shared file-backed pages are counted per process, not unique physical RAM. Final child CPU uses OS/report values, or the last available sample after an exit race.

Provenance.Scope: Only actual timed results, including skipped documents; source/status groups separate acceptance from attempts. PDF-text is confirmed by a raster peer, not claimed as dual OCR.
Provenance.CounterDefinitions: PDF-text and GOST attempts/acceptances count matched-page route attempts/successes; engine reads count field images submitted, including fallback. A Paddle batch of three fields counts three reads. MatchingCalls counts page-level matcher calls. Model choices may be cached per template; text/recognition results are not cached.

Scope: Repeated synthetic inputs, not original user PDFs. Vector results do not establish speed on raster scans; independent jobs may use different CPU models.
